DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 貼り紙が続いて不安だとのことですね。今、ご自宅の近くに相手がいるなど、差し迫った心配はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are worried about repeated notes being posted. Is there any immediate concern, such as the person being near your home now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は誰も見かけていません。ただ、玄関の扉に、帰りが遅いことを書いた匿名の紙が二度貼られていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在は人を見かけず、帰宅が遅いことを記した匿名紙が扉に二度あったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not seen anyone now. But an anonymous note mentioning my late returns home has been stuck to my front door twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you see no one now, but anonymous notes about your late returns were on your door twice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙を見つけた日時と、書かれていた内容を記録されていますか。書いた人を見たことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you recorded when you found them and what they said? Have you seen who wrote them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見つけた日の写真はありますが、貼った時刻は分かりません。隣の人かと思ったものの、書いた所は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見日の写真はあるが貼付時刻は不明で、隣人と思っただけで書いた所は見ていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have photos from the discovery days, but do not know when they were posted. I thought it might be a neighbor, but did not see anyone writing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have photos from the discovery days but posting times are unknown, and only suspected a neighbor without seeing them write. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た事実と推測を分けて伺います。紙は残っていますか。また、ご自身で返事を書いたり、どなたかを訪ねたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish observed facts from guesses. Do you still have the notes? Have you written a reply or visited anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚とも袋に入れて残しています。返事は書かず、隣の家にも行っていません。写真だけでなく元の紙も見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の二枚を保管し返事や隣家訪問はしておらず、写真と原本を確認してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I kept both in a bag. I have not replied or visited the neighboring home. Please check the originals as well as the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you kept both originals, did not reply or visit the neighbor, and ask for the photos and originals to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの記録を確認します。住宅の管理者へも、貼り紙があった事実は伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your records. Have you also told the housing manager that the notes appeared?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。警察に相談すれば管理者への連絡も済むと思っていましたが、管理者にも見つけた状況を別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者未連絡で警察相談が連絡代わりと思ったが、発見状況を管理者へ別途相談すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I thought consulting police would also notify the manager, but I will separately discuss how I found them with the manager.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the manager has not been contacted, you thought police consultation replaced that, but will discuss the discovery separately with the manager. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理者が対応できることと、こちらで伺う内容は分けて確認しましょう。紙を書いた相手や、行為の判断は、今の段階では確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's distinguish what the manager can handle from what we hear here. We cannot determine the writer or how to assess the conduct at this stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手を隣の人と決めて責めるのはやめます。二度の記録を順に説明し、また紙が来たり危険を感じたりした時の相談方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 隣人と断定して責めず二度の記録を順に説明し、再発や危険時の相談方法を教えてほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stop assuming and blaming my neighbor. I will explain the two records in order. Please also tell me how to seek advice if another note appears or I feel danger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not identify and blame the neighbor as certain; explain both records in order and ask how to consult upon recurrence or danger. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二枚を見つけた順に拝見します。新たな状況があれば追加でお知らせください。今すぐ危険が生じたときは、速やかに緊急の助けを求めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's look at the notes in discovery order. Tell us of new developments. If immediate danger arises, promptly seek emergency help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱に前の伝票が残っていますね。今回お送りになる住所は、こちらと同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The old shipping label remains on the box. Is today's destination the same address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その伝票は、この箱が家に届いたときのものです。今回は友人に衣類を送るので、別の住所のメモを持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残る伝票は自宅へ届いた時のもので、今回は友人へ衣類を送り別住所メモがあると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: That label was from when this box arrived at my home. This time I am sending clothes to a friend and have a note of a different address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the remaining label is from delivery to your home, while this shipment is clothes to a friend with a different-address note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の送り先と差出人を、古い伝票と分けて確認しましょう。メモの住所は、ご友人の現在のお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check this recipient and sender separately from the old label. Is the note your friend's current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人がしばらく泊まっている親戚の家です。友人の自宅の住所ではないので、どの名前で受け取れるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送り先は友人の一時滞在する親戚宅で、受取可能な名前は未確認と説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a relative's home where my friend is staying temporarily, not their own home. I have not asked which name can receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the destination is a relative's home where your friend temporarily stays, and the acceptable recipient name is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際に受け取れる宛名や住所の書き方を、先にご友人へ確認してください。中身は衣類だけでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First ask your friend the actual receivable name and address format. Are the contents only clothing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中身は上着とズボンです。友人に受取名と滞在先の表記を確認し、返事が来るまでは新しい伝票を書き上げないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身は上着とズボンと答え、友人に宛名と滞在先表記を聞き返信前に伝票を完成させないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: A jacket and trousers. I will check the recipient name and temporary address format with my friend, and not finish the new label before their reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the contents are a jacket and trousers; ask your friend the recipient name and address wording, and leave the label unfinished until the reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後、今回の情報だけで分かるようにする扱いもご案内します。差出人の欄は、ご自身の今の住所を使うご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After confirmation we will also explain how to make only this shipment's information clear. Will the sender field use your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。古い伝票には私の前の住所もあるので、それを写さず今の住所をメモから確認します。送り先と差出人の欄を取り違えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧伝票の自分の旧住所を写さず現在住所を確認し、宛先と差出人の欄を取り違えないようにしたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The old label also has my previous address, so I will not copy it; I will check my current address from my note. I want to avoid mixing up recipient and sender fields.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not copy your old address from the label, will check the current one, and want to avoid confusing recipient and sender fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つを照合してから、箱の大きさや重さに応じた方法を確認しましょう。お届けの希望日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After comparing those, let's check methods for the box's size and weight. Have you decided a preferred delivery date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の滞在中に届いてほしいですが、日付はまだ約束しません。受取先が確かになってから、料金と配達の見込みを聞いて発送を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 滞在中の配達を希望するが日付は約束せず、宛先確認後に料金と見込みを聞いて発送を決めると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want it delivered during my friend's stay, but will not promise a date yet. Once the destination is confirmed, I will ask the price and delivery estimate before deciding to ship.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Want delivery during the stay without promising a date, and decide after confirming the destination, price, and estimated delivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日は宛先確認の相談までとして箱をお返しします。ご友人の返事が届いたら、今回の住所メモと一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will stop at destination advice today and return the box. When your friend replies, bring it with this shipment's address note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家賃の振込先を変えるかどうかで、ご相談でしょうか。変更の案内はどのように届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking whether to change the rent transfer account? How did the change notice arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 管理会社の名前のメールで、今月から別の口座に送るように来ました。銀行で受取人名が出れば、本当に変更されたと分かると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 管理会社名のメールで別口座を指定され、銀行の名義表示で変更の真偽も分かると思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: An email in the management company's name said to send to a different account from this month. I thought seeing the recipient name at the bank would prove the change was real.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an email under the management company's name specified another account, and you thought the bank's name display also verified the change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座名義の表示を確認することと、依頼が正しいかを確かめることは別です。これまでの振込先や連絡先は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking the account name and verifying a request are separate. Do you know the previous account and contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約の案内に以前の口座と管理会社の電話番号があります。今回のメールには別の番号もありますが、どちらが正しいか確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約案内に旧口座と連絡先があり、メールの別番号との真偽は未確認と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract guide has the old account and management phone number. This email has another number, but I have not checked which is genuine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the contract guide has the old account and contact, and the email's different number is not verified. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらではメールを送った相手の真偽を決められません。前からご存じの連絡先を使って、変更の有無を先方へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine who really sent the email here. Use a contact you already know to check with them whether there is a change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールの番号だけを頼らず、契約の案内の連絡先へ尋ねます。確認前には新しい口座へ振り込まず、急いで二つに送ることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 従来の契約連絡先へ尋ね、確認前に新口座や両口座へ送らないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not rely only on the email number, but ask the contract-guide contact. I will not transfer to the new account before checking, or rush to send to both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use the established contract contact and send to neither the new account nor both accounts before confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できたら、使う口座の情報と金額を改めて照合しましょう。振込の費用についても、ご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once confirmed, let's compare the account information and amount again. Are you also unsure about transfer fees?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールに手数料を引いて送るような表現がありますが、家賃から引いてよいかは分かりません。銀行の手数料と、相手へ払う金額を別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メールの手数料差引表現が不明で、銀行手数料と相手へ払う金額を別に確認したいと尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The email seems to say deduct a fee before sending, but I do not know whether I may deduct it from rent. I want to check the bank fee separately from the amount paid to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check bank fees separately from the recipient's payment amount because the email's fee-deduction wording is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 銀行で必要な手数料は実行前にご案内します。家賃として必要な金額や負担の取り決めは、管理会社への照会や契約の案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain bank fees before execution. Check the rent amount and cost-sharing agreement through the management company or contract guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理会社へ口座変更と支払額の両方を確認します。返事と元の案内を持ってから相談し直し、今日は振込を実行しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理会社へ口座変更と支払額を確認し、返信と元資料で再相談して今日は実行しないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check both account change and payment amount with management. I will consult again with their reply and original guide, and not make a transfer today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check account change and payment amount with management, consult again with the reply and original material, and not execute today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、本日は情報の確認までにしましょう。正しい依頼かが分かるまで操作を進めず、確認できた資料を次回お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's only check information today. Do not proceed until the request is verified; bring confirmed materials next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お支払い前に確認したいことがあると伺いました。お買い物の中に、用途の違う物がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wanted to check before paying. Are there items for different purposes in your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食品は自分用で、掃除用品は職場の頼まれ物です。まとめて払っても、後で職場分だけの領収書を出せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の食品と職場用掃除品をまとめて払っても後で職場分の領収書を出せると思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The food is for me and cleaning supplies are for work. I thought I could pay together and get a work-only receipt afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought personal food and workplace cleaning supplies could be paid together and a work-only receipt obtained later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 後から必ず分け直せるとは限りません。どの商品を職場用として分けたいのか、先に教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may not always be possible to separate afterward. Please tell me first which products you want separated for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この掃除用品二つだけが職場用です。まだ決済していないので、食品と分けて会計できるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掃除用品二つだけが職場用と示し、未決済なので食品と会計を分けられるか確認を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only these two cleaning products are for work. I have not paid yet, so please check whether they can be billed separately from the food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that only two cleaning products are for work and ask to separate checkout from food before payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録を確認します。お持ち帰りの袋も、職場用とご自宅用で分けるご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the register. Do you want bags separated for work and home too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 食品には自分の袋を使い、職場用には別の袋が必要です。袋の料金がかかる場合は、どちらの会計に入れるか先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食品は持参袋、職場用は別袋を希望し、有料なら袋代をどちらへ入れるか事前相談したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use my own bag for food and need another for work. If there is a bag charge, I want to discuss which bill includes it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say food goes in your own bag and work needs another, and you want to discuss which checkout includes any bag fee in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の扱いも確認します。お支払いは二つの会計で同じ方法になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check bags too. Will the payment method be the same for both checkouts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の分は現金、職場の分はこのカードを希望します。使えるかを確認して、職場分の書類の出し方も決済前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私用は現金、職場用はカードを希望し、カード利用と書類方法を決済前に確認してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Cash for mine, this card for work. Please check whether it is accepted and explain work-document arrangements before payment too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request cash for personal items and card for work, asking about card acceptance and documents before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードと書類の取扱いを確認します。領収書の宛名など、職場から具体的な指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check card and document arrangements. Does work specify the receipt addressee or anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社名の正式な表記が携帯にあるので見直します。商品の分け方、袋、宛名と金額を確認し、二つの会計が整ってから払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯の正式社名を見直し、商品区分・袋・宛名・金額と二会計の準備を確認してから払うと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The formal company name is on my phone, so I will recheck it. I will check product separation, bags, addressee, and amount, and pay after both bills are ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the formal company name on your phone, product division, bags, addressee, amount, and both prepared bills before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、職場用の商品から登録内容と書類条件を確認します。確認が済むまでお支払いを進めず、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's start with work products' registration and document conditions. Do not proceed with payment until checks are done; wait as you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 距離の表示について確かめたいのですね。どの場所まで歩こうとお考えでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check the distance sign. Where are you considering walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この見晴らし場所まで行って戻りたいです。矢印の横の距離が、往復全部の長さだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見晴らし場所へ往復したく、矢印横の距離を全行程の長さと思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to this viewpoint and back. I thought the distance beside the arrow was the entire return journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain wanting a return walk to the viewpoint and mistaking the arrow's distance for the whole journey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示は、ここから見晴らし場所へ向かう片道の案内です。戻る道も含めて考える必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That sign indicates one way from here to the viewpoint. You also need to include the return path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片道の表示だったのですね。短い往復だと思っていましたが、同じ道を戻るなら、自分が考えたより長くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片道表示と分かり、短い往復と思ったが同じ道を戻れば想定より長いと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is one way. I thought it was a short return walk, but returning on the same path makes it longer than I expected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you now understand it is one way, and the same-path return makes the supposedly short walk longer than expected. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図で戻る道を確認しましょう。途中の休憩も含めて、今日はどのくらいの散歩にしたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the return path on the map. Including rests, how long a walk do you want today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 久しぶりに歩くので、見晴らし場所まで行くことより、疲れたら早く戻れることを優先したいです。近くで折り返せる範囲を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 久しぶりの散歩で見晴らし場所到達より早く戻れることを優先し、近い折返し範囲を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has been a while since I walked, so being able to return early if tired matters more than reaching the viewpoint. I want to know a nearby turning-back area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say this is your first walk in a while, prioritize an early return over reaching the viewpoint, and ask where to turn back nearby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口寄りの道を確認できます。休憩場所の表示はありますが、席が使えるかや、その場の状況は確かめる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check paths near the entrance. Rest spots are marked, but seat availability and conditions there need checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必ず座れると思って距離を延ばさず、近い所の様子を見ます。戻るときに別の道へ出ないよう、折り返す目印も決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席を前提に延ばさず近くの様子を見て、別の道へ出ない折返しの目印も決めたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not extend the distance assuming a seat, and will look nearby. I also want a turning landmark so I do not enter another path on return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not go farther assuming seats, will observe nearby, and choose a turning landmark to avoid a different return path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図の現在地と、候補の目印を照合しましょう。目印に着く前でも、疲れを感じたら目的地にこだわらず戻ることをお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's compare the current location and candidate landmark on the map. Even before it, consider returning if tired without insisting on the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口と折り返し候補を図で指して確かめます。目印まで行くと約束せず、往路だけでなく戻りの分も残して短く歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口と候補目印を図で確認し、到達を約束せず帰路の余力も残して短く歩くと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will point to and check the entrance and turning options on the map. I will not promise to reach the landmark; I will walk briefly, keeping energy for the return too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the entrance and candidate landmark on the map, do not promise to reach it, and say you will keep return energy for a short walk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、現在地からの道と帰りの方向を一緒に確認します。案内を見終わってから、ご自身の調子に合わせてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the path from here and return direction together. After the guidance, set out according to your condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車案内を見比べていらっしゃいますね。時刻と運行状況のどちらを確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing departure information. Do you want to check the timetable or operating status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯の予定ではもう発車する時刻なのに、駅の表示は遅延です。予定時刻を過ぎても、この列車が出るとは決まっていないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の予定時刻と駅の遅延表示が違い、時刻を過ぎても発車未定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone schedule says it is already departure time, but the station says delayed. Even past the scheduled time, is departure still not decided?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether departure remains uncertain despite the phone's scheduled time having passed and the station showing delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定時刻と実際の発車は別です。今は発車見込みの更新を待つ状態です。到着後に動かせないご予定がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Scheduled and actual departure differ. We are waiting for the estimated departure update. Do you have a fixed appointment after arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事の打合せがあります。到着が難しければオンライン参加に替えたいので、先方へ遅れる可能性を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事の打合せがあり到着困難ならオンラインへ替えたいので先方へ遅延可能性を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: A work meeting. If arrival is difficult, I want to switch to online attendance, so will tell them I may be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have a work meeting, want online attendance if arrival is difficult, and will inform them of possible delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加方法の変更は先方にご確認ください。駅で通信や通話場所を必ず用意できるとはお約束できません。経路を替えることもお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check attendance changes with them. We cannot promise communication facilities or a calling place at the station. Are you considering another route too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先方がオンライン参加を認めるか聞いてから考えます。返事の前に別の切符を買わず、今の切符の扱いも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: オンライン参加可否の返答前に別切符を買わず、今の切符の扱いを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will think after asking whether online attendance is allowed. I will not buy another ticket before their reply, and want to check the current ticket's handling too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not buy another ticket before the online-attendance reply and want to know the current ticket's handling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切符の種類で担当や条件が変わります。購入先と、切符を確認できるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible contact and conditions depend on ticket type. Do you have the purchase source and something showing the ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯で買ったこの切符です。取消のボタンはまだ押していません。払い戻せると思って操作せず、先に条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯購入の切符を示し、取消ボタンを押さず払い戻し条件を先に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the ticket bought on my phone. I have not pressed cancel. I want the conditions first, rather than operate it assuming a refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the phone-bought ticket and say you have not pressed cancel and want refund conditions first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面を拝見して問い合わせ先を確認します。遅延しているだけで、すべての切符が同じ扱いになるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will look at the screen and check the inquiry contact. Delay alone does not mean all tickets receive the same treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 打合せ先には参加方法を相談し、切符は条件がわかるまで操作しません。列車も予定時刻だけで判断せず、更新された表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先方に参加方法を相談し、切符は条件確認まで操作せず列車の更新表示も見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will discuss attendance with the meeting contact and leave the ticket untouched until conditions are clear. I will also check updated train displays rather than judge only by scheduled time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss attendance, not operate the ticket until conditions are checked, and watch updated train displays. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では切符の購入先を確認してご案内します。先方への連絡が済んだら、最新表示と合わせて移動の予定を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the purchase source and guide you. After you contact them, consider travel plans with the latest display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約の案内をお持ちですね。案内に書かれたお名前は、ご本人のお名前でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have consultation booking guidance. Is the name on it your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫の名前です。家族の相談だと思って、私の住所の書類の質問も一緒にできるつもりで来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約は夫名義だが家族の相談として自分の住所書類も聞けると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My husband's. I thought it was a family consultation and came expecting to ask about my address documents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the booking is in your husband's name but you thought a family consultation also covered your address documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約された相談内容を確認する必要があります。ご主人の相談に同席することと、ご自身の別の相談をすることは分けて伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the booked subject. Let's distinguish attending your husband's consultation from having your own separate consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の質問は別の用件なのですね。まず夫の相談へ同席できるか、予約の担当に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の質問は別用件と理解し、まず夫の相談に同席できるか予約担当へ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So my question is a separate matter. First I want booking staff to check whether I may attend my husband's consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize your question as separate and ask booking staff first whether you can attend your husband's consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同席の希望を担当に伝えます。ご自身の用件については、どの書類のどこで迷っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will relay your attendance request. For your own matter, which document and part are unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この住所の案内の連絡先が読めず、どの窓口へ行くのかわかりません。夫の相談時間を使う前に、別の担当を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所案内の連絡先を読めず窓口不明で、夫の時間を使う前に別担当を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot read the contact on this address guide and do not know which counter. Before using my husband's consultation time, please tell me a separate person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot read the address-guide contact and do not know the counter, and want a separate contact before using your husband's time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内を拝見して相談先を調べます。言葉の支援も必要であれば、ご希望を伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look at the guide and find the contact. If language assistance is needed, we can hear your preferences too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夫に全部訳してもらうつもりでしたが、私の書類は自分でも確認したいです。難しい言葉を短い文に言い換えてもらう希望を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夫の通訳だけに頼らず自分の書類を確認したく、短い文への言い換え希望を伝えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I planned to have my husband translate everything, but want to check my own documents myself too. Please convey that I want difficult language rephrased into short sentences.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to relay a preference for short-sentence rephrasing so you can check your documents without relying only on your husband. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を別の担当へ伝えます。同じ日に対応できるかは、空き状況などの確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will relay that to the separate staff. Same-day help depends on checking availability and other conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夫への同席と私の相談を別々に申し出ます。今日まとめてできると決めず、私の担当窓口と次に相談できる方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夫への同席と自分の相談を分け、当日一括を前提とせず担当と次の相談方法を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will request attending my husband's consultation separately from my own. I will not assume both can be done today, and will ask my counter and next consultation methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate accompanying your husband from your own consultation, and ask the responsible counter and next methods without assuming same-day completion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では夫の予約案内とご自身の住所の案内を分けてお持ちください。両方の担当へ、同席と相談の希望を取り次ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep your husband's booking guide and your address guide separately. We will relay attendance and consultation wishes to both staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類をもう一度ご覧になっていますね。お会計のあとに確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the documents again. Is there something to check after paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ支払いの書類を出したいのですが、受け取ったこの二枚のうち、どちらが領収書なのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ支払い書類を出すため、受け取った二枚のどちらが領収書か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to submit payment documents to work, but do not know which of these two sheets is the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two received sheets is the receipt for submitting payment documents to work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見すると、こちらは診療の明細、もう一枚は次回の予約票です。領収書が別にあるか、会計担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a treatment breakdown and the other is the next appointment slip. Let's ask billing whether there is a separate receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚とは別なのですね。かばんも見ましたが見つかりません。会計のときに渡されたかどうかも覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚とは別と理解し、かばんにもなく会計時に受け取ったかも不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is separate from these two. I checked my bag but cannot find it, and do not remember whether it was handed to me at payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you understand it is separate, it is not in your bag, and you are unsure whether you received it at payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取っていないのか、受け取って見当たらないのか、今は決めずにそのまま伝えます。お支払いの方法は説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will relay that without deciding whether it was never received or was received and lost. Can you describe your payment method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓口で現金を払いました。時刻はおおよそなら言えますが、手元の紙に自分で「支払済み」と書いて代わりにするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金払いで時刻は概ね説明できるが、自分で支払済みと記して代用しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I paid cash at the counter. I can give an approximate time, but will not write 'paid' on my own paper as a substitute.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you paid cash and can give an approximate time, but will not mark your paper 'paid' as a substitute. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計の記録と書類の扱いは担当に照会します。職場からは、原本か写しかなどの指定もありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask billing about records and documents. Did work specify originals or copies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払いがわかるものとだけ言われ、原本かは聞いていません。職場への確認とは別に、領収書の発行状況を調べてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場の原本指定は未確認と伝え、別途領収書の発行状況の照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They only said something showing payment; I have not asked about originals. Separately from checking with work, please investigate whether a receipt was issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say work's original requirement is unconfirmed and separately request a receipt-issuance check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの確認を分けましょう。再発行が可能か、費用が必要かも、現時点で私から確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's separate those checks. I cannot confirm reissue availability or fees now either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では明細と予約票は捨てずに持ちます。会計担当に発行状況と必要な手続きを聞き、職場には原本が必要かを確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明細と予約票を保持し、会計に発行状況と手続き、職場に原本要否を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the breakdown and appointment slip. I will ask billing about issuance and needed procedures, and work whether the original is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will retain the breakdown and appointment slip, ask billing about issuance and procedures, and work about originals. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の経緯を会計担当へお伝えします。二枚の書類をお手元に置き、照会のご案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will relay the circumstances to billing. Keep the two sheets to hand and wait for inquiry guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 眼鏡を入れたケースが見当たらないとのことですね。最後に確かめた場面を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find the case containing your glasses. Please describe the last confirmed occasion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼に食堂で眼鏡を外してケースに入れました。その後は買い物をしたので、食堂で落としたのか店で落としたのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼の食堂で眼鏡をケースへ入れ、その後買物をしたためなくした場所は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At lunch I removed my glasses in the dining hall and put them in the case. I shopped afterward, so do not know whether I dropped it there or at a shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain putting glasses in the case at the dining hall at noon, then shopping, leaving the loss location unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を一つに決めず、行動の順番を伺います。ケースの外からわかる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than fix one location, we will ask the sequence. Are there recognizable outside features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 灰色で丸い形のケースです。外には名前がありませんが、中の眼鏡拭きに私の名前が刺しゅうされています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外は灰色で丸く無記名、内側の眼鏡拭きに氏名刺しゅうがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A round gray case. No name outside, but my name is embroidered on the glasses cloth inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe a round gray unnamed exterior and your name embroidered on the cloth inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外見と中の特徴を分けて記録します。似た届け物があっても、それだけでご本人の物とは確定しません。写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record exterior and interior separately. A similar item handed in alone would not prove ownership. Do you have a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ型の商品の写真なら見せられます。でも自分のケースを撮ったものではないので、参考の画像として扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同型商品の写真だけで本人所有物の写真ではないと説明し、参考画像として提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can show a photo of the same model. But it is not my own case, so please treat it as a reference image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the photo is only the same product model, not your own item, and present it as a reference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参考画像として確認します。なくした物に、ご連絡先やカードなども入っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check it as reference. Were contact details, cards, or anything else in the lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードは入れていません。眼鏡と名前入りの布だけです。連絡は、ケースの中ではなく、この用紙に私の電話番号を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードはなく眼鏡と名入り布だけで、連絡番号は相談用紙に書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No cards. Only glasses and a named cloth. I will write my phone on this form, not inside the case, for contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there are no cards, just glasses and a named cloth, and you will write your contact number on the consultation form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで連絡方法を確認します。食堂や買い物先へは、すでに問い合わせていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check contact arrangements here. Have you already asked the dining hall or shops?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。両方に問い合わせ、見つかった場合はこの相談先にも知らせます。場所を思い出せない点は、そのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食堂と買物先への問い合わせは未実施で、両方に聞き発見時は相談先へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will ask both and notify this consultation contact if found. I will leave the fact that I cannot remember the location unchanged in my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say neither dining hall nor shops have been asked yet, you will ask both and notify this contact if found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では順に伺った特徴を読み返します。行動した二か所と参考画像を確認し、遺失の相談を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's read back the features in order. We will check both visited places and the reference image, then proceed with the loss inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票と携帯の画面をお持ちですね。すでに何か受け取りの申し込みをされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice and phone screen. Have you already requested any receipt arrangement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 再配達を申し込みましたが、今日は外出できたので窓口で受け取れたらと思って来ました。二つを同時に頼んだことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達申込後に窓口へ来たため、同時に二つ頼む扱いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I requested redelivery, but could go out today and came hoping to collect at the counter. Does that mean I requested both at once?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether coming for counter collection after requesting redelivery counts as two simultaneous requests. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し込みの内容と今の荷物の所在を確認します。まず、不在票の番号と申し込み画面の番号を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your request and parcel location. First show the notice number and the application-screen number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二つです。番号は同じですが、窓口受取への変更ができたとは表示されていません。家を空けたままでもよいか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの番号は同じだが窓口変更の完了表示はなく、家を空けてよいか気になると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two. The numbers match, but it does not show a completed change to counter collection. I am concerned whether I may stay away from home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say both numbers match but no completed counter-change display appears, and you are concerned about being away from home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ変更が確定しているとは言えません。すでに配達へ持ち出されている可能性もあるため、確認前に受け取れるとはお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot yet say the change is confirmed. The parcel may already be out for delivery, so cannot promise collection before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ここに荷物がある前提で待たず、まず所在を調べてもらいます。再配達の申し込みを取り消す操作も、今はしないほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物の所在確認を先に依頼し、再配達取消の操作を今すべきか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please check its location first, rather than my waiting assuming it is here. Should I also avoid canceling the redelivery request now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request location checking first and ask whether you should cancel redelivery now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取消や変更の順番も担当に確認します。重ねて操作せず、その画面を残しておいてください。窓口受取に必要な資料もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask staff about the order of cancellation and changes too. Do not repeat operations; retain that screen. We will also explain counter-collection requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手元に不在票と本人確認に使う書類はあります。今日の持ち物だけで受け取れるかは、荷物の種類を見て確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在票と本人確認用書類はあるが、荷物種別に応じて持ち物が足りるか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the notice and identity-check documents. Please check against parcel type whether today's items alone are sufficient to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the notice and identity documents, but request a sufficiency check based on parcel type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、必要資料は荷物に応じて確認します。保管期限もこちらに書かれていますので、変更方法と一緒にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, required documents depend on the parcel. The holding deadline is also written here; we will explain it with the change method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取方法が決まったら日時と保管期限を控えます。今は再配達も窓口受取も、自分で二重に確定したことにしないで返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 決まった方法の日時と期限を控え、二重に確定したと自己判断せず返答を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once the receipt method is decided, I will note its time and holding deadline. For now I will wait for a reply, not decide myself that both redelivery and counter collection are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the decided method's time and deadline and await the reply without assuming both methods are confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では番号から担当へ照会します。不在票と申し込み画面をそのままご用意いただき、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will ask the responsible staff using the number. Keep the notice and application screen as they are, and wait here.
